text: Discipline Positioning:It belongs to the medical category of majors, with a study period of 5 years, and confers a Bachelor of Medicine degree. This major originated from the combination of ophthalmology and optometry, aiming to address the diagnosis and treatment of eye diseases and visual health issues. Currently, it is offered in many medical colleges and universities in China, such as Wenzhou Medical University, Tianjin Medical University, and Capital Medical University.Core features:It is necessary to master both basic and clinical medical knowledge (such as the diagnosis and treatment of ophthalmic diseases), as well as be proficient in optometry theories (such as refractive error correction and visual function assessment).Emphasize practical operation and stress the cultivation of skills such as ophthalmic examination, optometry and spectacle fitting, and visual rehabilitation.
